decisions.meaning: Continue towards the complete tool, with bounded evidence-based engineering; do not ask again whether to continue.

decisions.user_words: 交接文件中必須要寫明，本專案最核心的目標是要打造一個 LINE 相簿備份工具。由使用者指定群組名稱，使用者打開相簿列表之後，可以自動點擊並自動下載所有相簿中的照片到指定的資料夾存放，過程中都不需要人工介入。可以使用所有的視覺定位，包含但不限於 OCR、computer use 等相關功能，還有 macOS 原生的相關視覺輔助技術。
decisions.meaning: Unattended batch product is the core goal; OCR, Computer Use and macOS native visual/accessibility capabilities are allowed. Current one-album test is a milestone, not product completion.

decisions.user_words: 然後我明確授權接下來的任務可以直接去點擊我所指定的 LINE 相簿，然後做實際的測試。
decisions.meaning: Next task may freshly identify and click the confirmed 182-photo album and conduct actual backup testing within the selected project/config destination and existing safety rules. No repeated blanket permission request. Historical exhausted attempts remain historical; this is a newly authorized next test task, not retroactive waiver/reset or authority to repeat an uncertain Save All.

scope_notes: Current requested deliverable remains handoff and explicitly authorized git add/commit/push; no LINE actions occur in this documentation publication unit.
No authority to delete/overwrite existing backups, alter historical facts, weaken barriers, operate other groups/albums, or send external messages.
The complete unattended all-albums tool is the product goal. Current next real test is limited to the specified 182-photo album; current config max_albums_per_run=1 remains until reviewed batch work.
